A '''T-series tactical droid''' was stationed on [[Kiros/Legends|Kiros]] under the command of [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] [[Darts D'Nar/Legends|Darts D'Nar]]. He was destroyed after a bomb on his back was activated, and subsequently [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force pushed]] out of a window by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].
